```{r Data Summarization Script for GAM_MCS, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE,fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr) # has the function str_detect()
library(patchwork) # For printing grids of ggplot
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel) # For labelling plot outliers
library(dunn.test)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggsignif)
library(pracma)

# Set project root directory.
PROJ <- local({
  for (cand in c(getwd(), dirname(getwd()), ".")) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(cand, "run_all.R")) ||
        (file.exists(file.path(cand, "2022AjaxData.xlsx")) && file.exists(file.path(cand, "2022PickeringData.xlsx"))) ||
        dir.exists(file.path(cand, "Outputs", "Excel Files REMOTE")) ||
        dir.exists(file.path(cand, "Excel Files REMOTE"))) {
      return(normalizePath(cand))
    }
  }
  getwd()
})

# Set results directory.
RESULTS_DIR <- Sys.getenv("GAM_RESULTS_DIR", "")
if (!nzchar(RESULTS_DIR)) {
  if (dir.exists(file.path(PROJ, "Outputs", "Excel Files REMOTE"))) {
    RESULTS_DIR <- "Outputs/Excel Files REMOTE"
  } else if (dir.exists(file.path(PROJ, "Excel Files REMOTE"))) {
    RESULTS_DIR <- "Excel Files REMOTE"
  } else {
    RESULTS_DIR <- "Clean Baseline Outputs"
  }
}
if (!dir.exists(file.path(PROJ, RESULTS_DIR))) {
  stop("Results directory not found: ", file.path(PROJ, RESULTS_DIR),
    "\n  Set GAM_RESULTS_DIR to the folder holding the *_GAM-metrics.xlsx files.")
}
cat("Project directory:", PROJ, "\n")
cat("Results directory:", RESULTS_DIR, "\n")

{
  # Define model set.
  setwd(file.path(PROJ, RESULTS_DIR))

  # Exclude 1-day control arm from pooled aggregates.
  INCLUDE_1D_IN_POOLED <- TRUE

  SMA <- vector("list")
  type <- vector("list")
  age <- vector("list")
  city <- vector("list")
  data_list <- list()

  devdrop_list <- c("InfADropDevPct", "NoroDropDevPct", "EVDropDevPct")
  metric_list <- c("mean_dev", "mean_edf") # ,'sd_dev','IQR')
  metric_name_list <- c("Deviance Explained", "Effective Degrees of Freedom") # ,'Standard Deviation','Interquartile Range')
  group_list <- c("SMA", "age", "type", "city")
  file_matches <- list.files(pattern = ".*_GAM-values.xlsx|.*_GAM-metrics.xlsx", full.names = TRUE)
  file_matchesMCS <- list.files(pattern = ".*_GAM-Monte-Carlo.xlsx", full.names = TRUE)
  file_names <- gsub("\\.xlsx$", "", basename(file_matches))


  # Extract Excel data
  for (file in file_matches) {
    df <- read_excel(file, col_names = TRUE)
    
    # Post-process filter: Exclude models with ACF > 0.4
    if ("ACFResidual" %in% names(df)) {
      df <- df[df$ACFResidual <= 0.4, ]
    }
    for (col in names(df)) {
      if (nrow(df) == 0) {
        zero_row <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(df)))
        colnames(zero_row) <- colnames(df)
        df <- zero_row
      }
    }
    data_list[[basename(file)]] <- df
  }
  for (file in file_matchesMCS) {
    base_file <- basename(file)
    fileMCS <- paste0(substr(base_file, start = 1, stop = nchar(base_file) - 16), "metrics.xlsx")
    corresponding_metrics <- data_list[str_detect(names(data_list), pattern = fileMCS)]
    if (length(corresponding_metrics) != 0) {
      offset <- as.character(corresponding_metrics[[1]]$Offset)
      devexpl <- corresponding_metrics[[1]]$DevianceExplained
      if (devexpl != 0) {
        if (length(offset) != 0) {
          tryCatch(
            {
              df <- read_excel(file, col_names = TRUE, sheet = paste0(offset, "_prelog"))
            },
            error = function(e) {
              df <<- read_excel(file, col_names = TRUE, sheet = offset)
            }
          )
          data_list[[basename(file)]] <- df
        }
      }
    }
  }
  values_data <- data_list[str_detect(names(data_list), pattern = ".*_GAM-values")]
  dfs_list <- vector("list", length(values_data))

  # Organize data sheets
  for (i in seq_along(names(values_data))) {
    filename <- names(values_data[i])
    prefix <- substr(filename, start = 1, stop = nchar(filename) - 16)
    col_name <- colnames(values_data[[i]])[2]
    if (nrow(values_data[[i]] != 0)) {
      observed_df <- values_data[[i]] %>%
        select(!!sym(col_name)) %>%
        mutate(filename = filename)

      dfs_list[[i]] <- observed_df

      file_to_combine <- paste(substr(filename, 1, nchar(filename) - 11), "metrics.xlsx", sep = "")
      file_to_combineMCS <- paste(substr(filename, 1, nchar(filename) - 11), "Monte-Carlo.xlsx", sep = "")

      if (!is.null(data_list[[file_to_combine]])) {
        data_list[[file_to_combine]]$NRMSE <- data_list[[file_to_combine]]$RMSE / (max(observed_df[, 1]) - min(observed_df[, 1]))
        data_list[[file_to_combine]]$file <- file_to_combine

        data_list[[file_to_combine]] <- data_list[[file_to_combine]] %>%
          filter(!is.na(data_list[[file_to_combine]]$AICc))
      }

      if (!is.null(data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])) {
        data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]]$file <- file_to_combineMCS

        data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]] <- data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]] %>%
          filter(!is.na(data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]]$mean_dev))
      }

      is_1d <- grepl("Absent1d", filename)
      pool_ok <- INCLUDE_1D_IN_POOLED | !is_1d

      if (is_1d) {
        SMA[["1d_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["1d_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        SMA[["1d_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["1d_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (grepl("3d", filename)) {
        SMA[["3d_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["3d_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        SMA[["3d_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["3d_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (grepl("5d", filename)) {
        SMA[["5d_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["5d_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        SMA[["5d_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["5d_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (grepl("7d", filename)) {
        SMA[["7d_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["7d_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        SMA[["7d_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(SMA[["7d_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (pool_ok & (grepl("Elementary", filename))) {
        age[["Elementary_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(age[["Elementary_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        age[["Elementary_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(age[["Elementary_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (pool_ok & (grepl("Secondary", filename))) {
        age[["Secondary_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(age[["Secondary_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        age[["Secondary_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(age[["Secondary_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (pool_ok & (grepl("Total", filename))) {
        age[["Total_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(age[["Total_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        age[["Total_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(age[["Total_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (pool_ok & (grepl("percent", filename) & !grepl("percentchange", filename))) {
        type[["prevelance_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(type[["prevelance_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        type[["prevelance_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(type[["prevelance_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (pool_ok & (grepl("percentchange", filename))) {
        type[["incidence_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(type[["incidence_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        type[["incidence_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(type[["incidence_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (pool_ok & (grepl("Pickering", filename))) {
        city[["Pickering_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(city[["Pickering_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        city[["Pickering_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(city[["Pickering_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
      if (pool_ok & (grepl("Ajax", filename))) {
        city[["Ajax_Metrics"]] <- bind_rows(city[["Ajax_Metrics"]], data_list[[file_to_combine]])
        city[["Ajax_MCS"]] <- bind_rows(city[["Ajax_MCS"]], data_list[[file_to_combineMCS]])
      }
    }
  }
  # Stochastic simulation results.
  A_list <- c("3-day SMA", "Elementary", "percent", "pickering")
  A <- list("SMA$3d_MCS" = SMA$`3d_MCS`, "age$Elementary_MCS" = age$Elementary_MCS, "type$prevelance_MCS" = type$prevelance_MCS, "city$Pickering_MCS" = city$Pickering_MCS)
  B_list <- c("5-day SMA", "Secondary", "percentchange", "ajax")
  B <- list("SMA$5d_MCS" = SMA$`5d_MCS`, "age$Secondary_MCS" = age$Secondary_MCS, "type$incidence_MCS" = type$incidence_MCS, "city$Ajax_MCS" = city$Ajax_MCS)
  C_list <- c("7-day SMA", "Total", "type3", "city3")
  C <- list("SMA$7d_MCS" = SMA$`7d_MCS`, "age$Total_MCS" = age$Total_MCS, "type$prevelance_MCS" = type$prevelance_MCS, "city$Pickering_MCS" = city$Pickering_MCS)
  # Format 1-day control simulation plots.
  D_list <- c("1-day (raw)", "age4", "type4", "city4")
  D <- list("SMA$1d_MCS" = SMA$`1d_MCS`, "age$Total_MCS" = age$Total_MCS, "type$prevelance_MCS" = type$prevelance_MCS, "city$Pickering_MCS" = city$Pickering_MCS)

  # Format metric reporting
  for (g in 1:length(group_list)) {
    i <- 1

    for (metric in (metric_list)) {
      calc_summary <- function(df, metric) {
        if (is.null(df)) {
          return(data.frame())
        }
        df %>%
          filter(!is.na(noise_level)) %>%
          group_by(noise_level) %>%
          summarise(
            mean_metric = mean(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_metric = sd(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(.data[[metric]]))
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            se = sd_metric / sqrt(n),
            ci_lower = mean_metric - qt(0.975, n - 1) * se,
            ci_upper = mean_metric + qt(0.975, n - 1) * se
          )
      }
      if (metric == "mean_dev") {
        ymin <- 0
        ymax <- 1
        mid <- 0.5
      } else if (metric == "sd_dev") {
        ymin <- 0
        ymax <- 0.15
        mid <- 0.075
      } else if (metric == "IQR") {
        ymin <- 0
        ymax <- 0.25
        mid <- 0.1
      } else if (metric == "mean_edf") {
        ymin <- 0
        ymax <- 20
        mid <- -8
      }

      {
        # Compute simulation summaries across smoothing windows.
        SMA_1d_summary <- lapply(D[g], calc_summary, metric = metric)
        SMA_3d_summary <- lapply(A[g], calc_summary, metric = metric)
        SMA_5d_summary <- lapply(B[g], calc_summary, metric = metric)
        SMA_7d_summary <- lapply(C[g], calc_summary, metric = metric)

        SMA_1d_summary <- SMA_1d_summary[[1]]
        SMA_3d_summary <- SMA_3d_summary[[1]]
        SMA_5d_summary <- SMA_5d_summary[[1]]
        SMA_7d_summary <- SMA_7d_summary[[1]]

        # Ensure non-empty tibble structure.
        if (nrow(SMA_1d_summary) == 0) SMA_1d_summary <- tibble(noise_level = numeric(0), mean_metric = numeric(0), ci_lower = numeric(0), ci_upper = numeric(0))
        if (nrow(SMA_3d_summary) == 0) SMA_3d_summary <- tibble(noise_level = numeric(0), mean_metric = numeric(0), ci_lower = numeric(0), ci_upper = numeric(0))
        if (nrow(SMA_5d_summary) == 0) SMA_5d_summary <- tibble(noise_level = numeric(0), mean_metric = numeric(0), ci_lower = numeric(0), ci_upper = numeric(0))
        if (nrow(SMA_7d_summary) == 0) SMA_7d_summary <- tibble(noise_level = numeric(0), mean_metric = numeric(0), ci_lower = numeric(0), ci_upper = numeric(0))

        SMA_1d_summary <- na.omit(SMA_1d_summary)
        SMA_3d_summary <- na.omit(SMA_3d_summary)
        SMA_5d_summary <- na.omit(SMA_5d_summary)
        SMA_7d_summary <- na.omit(SMA_7d_summary)

        # 1-day (raw) plot
        SMA1d_line <- lm(SMA_1d_summary$mean_metric ~ SMA_1d_summary$noise_level)
        coef_vals_1d <- coef(SMA1d_line)
        intercept_1d <- coef_vals_1d[1]
        slope_1d <- coef_vals_1d[2]
        y_cross0.5_1d <- round((mid - intercept_1d) / slope_1d, 2)

        plot_SMA1d <- ggplot(SMA_1d_summary, aes(x = noise_level, y = mean_metric)) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#4A6FA5", alpha = 0.2) +
          geom_point(color = "#4A6FA5") +
          geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = mid, xend = 1, yend = mid),
            linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.4
          ) +
          scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Relative % Noise",
            limits = c(0, 1),
            breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
          ) +
          labs(
            title = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i], " \n- ", D_list[g]),
            y = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i])
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          ylim(ymin, ymax)

        # 3-day plot
        SMA3d_line <- lm(SMA_3d_summary$mean_metric ~ SMA_3d_summary$noise_level)
        coef_vals_3d <- coef(SMA3d_line)
        intercept_3d <- coef_vals_3d[1]
        slope_3d <- coef_vals_3d[2]

        y_cross0.5_3d <- (mid - intercept_3d) / slope_3d
        y_cross0.5_3d

        plot_SMA3d <- ggplot(SMA_3d_summary, aes(x = noise_level, y = mean_metric)) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#D40000", alpha = 0.2) +
          
          geom_point(color = "#D40000") +
          geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = mid, xend = 1, yend = mid),
            linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.4
          ) + # horizontal dashed line
          scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Relative % Noise",
            limits = c(0, 1),
            breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
          ) +
          labs(
            title = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i], " \n- ", A_list[g]),
            y = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i])
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          ylim(ymin, ymax)


        # 5-day plot
        SMA5d_line <- lm(SMA_5d_summary$mean_metric ~ SMA_5d_summary$noise_level)
        coef_vals_5d <- coef(SMA5d_line)
        intercept_5d <- coef_vals_5d[1]
        slope_5d <- coef_vals_5d[2]

        y_cross0.5_5d <- (mid - intercept_5d) / slope_5d
        y_cross0.5_5d <- round(y_cross0.5_5d, 2)

        plot_SMA5d <- ggplot(SMA_5d_summary, aes(x = noise_level, y = mean_metric)) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#8A040D", alpha = 0.2) +
          
          geom_point(color = "#8A040D") +
          geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = mid, xend = 1, yend = mid),
            linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.4
          ) +
          scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Relative % Noise",
            limits = c(0, 1),
            breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
          ) +
          labs(
            title = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i], " \n- ", B_list[g]),
            y = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i])
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          ylim(ymin, ymax)


        # 7-day plot
        SMA7d_line <- lm(SMA_7d_summary$mean_metric ~ SMA_7d_summary$noise_level)
        coef_vals_7d <- coef(SMA7d_line)
        intercept_7d <- coef_vals_7d[1]
        slope_7d <- coef_vals_7d[2]

        y_cross0.5_7d <- (mid - intercept_7d) / slope_7d
        y_cross0.5_7d

        plot_SMA7d <- ggplot(SMA_7d_summary, aes(x = noise_level, y = mean_metric)) +
          geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), fill = "#330000", alpha = 0.2) +
          
          geom_point(color = "#330000") +
          geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = mid, xend = 1, yend = mid),
            linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.4
          ) + # horizontal dashed line
          scale_x_continuous(
            name = "Relative % Noise",
            limits = c(0, 1),
            breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
          ) +
          labs(
            title = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i], " \n- ", C_list[g]),
            y = paste0("Mean ", metric_name_list[i])
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          ylim(ymin, ymax)

        if (D_list[g] == "1-day (raw)") {
          print(plot_SMA1d + plot_SMA3d + plot_SMA5d + plot_SMA7d)
          if (metric == "mean_dev") {
            print(paste0("For ", D_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_1d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_3d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_5d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
            print(paste0("For ", C_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_7d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
          } else {
            print(paste0("For ", D_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_1d, 2)))
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_3d, 2)))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_5d, 2)))
            print(paste0("For ", C_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_7d, 2)))
          }
        } else if (C_list[g] == "7-day SMA" || C_list[g] == "Total") {
          print(plot_SMA3d + plot_SMA5d + plot_SMA7d)
          if (metric == "mean_dev") {
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_3d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_5d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
            print(paste0("For ", C_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_7d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
          } else {
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_3d, 2)))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_5d, 2)))
            print(paste0("For ", C_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_7d, 2)))
          }
        } else {
          print(plot_SMA3d + plot_SMA5d)
          if (metric == "mean_dev") {
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_3d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g], ", Relative % Noise = ", round(y_cross0.5_5d, 2), ", when ", metric, " = ", mid))
          } else {
            print(paste0("For ", A_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_3d, 2)))
            print(paste0("For ", B_list[g], ", Slope = ", round(slope_5d, 2)))
          }
        }
      }

      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  print("-------------------------------- Stochastic Simulation Results End here --------------------------------")
  # Boxplots for SMA Deviance explained
  {
    SMAdev_df <- tibble(
      value = c(
        SMA$"1d_Metrics"$`DevianceExplained`,
        SMA$"3d_Metrics"$`DevianceExplained`,
        SMA$"5d_Metrics"$`DevianceExplained`,
        SMA$"7d_Metrics"$`DevianceExplained`
      ),
      SMA = c(
        rep("1-day", length(SMA$"1d_Metrics"$`DevianceExplained`)),
        rep("3-day", length(SMA$"3d_Metrics"$`DevianceExplained`)),
        rep("5-day", length(SMA$"5d_Metrics"$`DevianceExplained`)),
        rep("7-day", length(SMA$"7d_Metrics"$`DevianceExplained`))
      )
    )

    kruskal_test_SMAdev <- kruskal.test(value ~ SMA, data = SMAdev_df)
    if (kruskal_test_SMAdev$p.value < 0.05) {
      dunn_result_SMAdev <- dunn.test(
        x = SMAdev_df$value,
        g = SMAdev_df$SMA,
        method = "bonferroni"
      )
      print("SMA deviance explained dunn test results: ")
      dunn_df <- as.data.frame(dunn_result_SMAdev)
      print(dunn_df[dunn_df$P.adjusted < 0.05, ])
    } else {
      print(paste("SMA shows no significant difference for deviance explained, p-value =", kruskal_test_SMAdev$p.value))
    }
    SMAdev_df <- SMAdev_df %>%
      filter(SMAdev_df$value > 0)

    # Calculate global max for NRMSE to keep axis consistent
    max_nrmse <- max(c(
      SMA$"1d_Metrics"$`RMSE`, SMA$"3d_Metrics"$`RMSE`, SMA$"5d_Metrics"$`RMSE`, SMA$"7d_Metrics"$`RMSE`,
      age$"Elementary_Metrics"$`RMSE`, age$"Secondary_Metrics"$`RMSE`, age$"Total_Metrics"$`RMSE`,
      type$"percent_Metrics"$`RMSE`, type$"percentchange_Metrics"$`RMSE`,
      city$"Ajax_Metrics"$`RMSE`, city$"Pickering_Metrics"$`RMSE`
    ), na.rm = TRUE)

    SMAplot <- ggplot(SMAdev_df, aes(x = SMA, y = value)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(
        title = "Deviance Explained by various SMA",
        x = "Simple Moving Average (SMA) Window",
        y = "Deviance Explained"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
      theme(
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain"),

        city$"Ajax_Metrics"$`Offset`
      ),
      city = c(
        rep("Pickering", length(city$"Pickering_Metrics"$`Offset`)),
        rep("Ajax", length(city$"Ajax_Metrics"$`Offset`))
      )
    )

    wilcox_test_cityoff <- wilcox.test(value ~ city, data = cityoff_df, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)

    if (wilcox_test_cityoff$p.value < 0.05) {
      print(paste("Significant difference between cities (Mann-Whitney U test), p =", round(wilcox_test_cityoff$p.value, 4)))
    } else {
      print(paste("No significant difference between cities (Mann-Whitney U test), p =", round(wilcox_test_cityoff$p.value, 4)))
    }

    # Filter out non-positive dev values
    cityoff_df <- cityoff_df %>%
      filter(dev > 0)

    # Create the boxplot
    city3plot <- ggplot(cityoff_df, aes(x = city, y = value)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(

  max_devexpl <- data_list[[1]] %>%
    select(file, DevianceExplained)
  for (list in names(data_list)) {
    all_NRMSE <- data_list[[list]][["NRMSE"]]
    devexpl <- data_list[[list]][["DevianceExplained"]]
    sim <- data_list[[list]][["noise_level"]]

    if (!is.null(all_NRMSE)) {
      if (all_NRMSE < min_NRMSE$NRMSE) {
        min_NRMSE$NRMSE <- all_NRMSE
        min_NRMSE$file <- list
      }
      if (devexpl > max_devexpl$DevianceExplained) {
        max_devexpl$DevianceExplained <- devexpl
        max_devexpl$file <- list
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(sim)) {
      devsim <- data_list[[list]] %>%
        select(file, noise_level, mean_dev)
      devsim_line <- lm(devsim$mean_dev ~ devsim$noise_level)
      coef_vals_devsim <- coef(devsim_line)
      intercept_devsim <- coef_vals_devsim[1]
      slope_devsim <- coef_vals_devsim[2]

      y_cross0.5_devsim <- round((0.5 - intercept_devsim) / slope_devsim, 2)
      if (y_cross0.5_devsim > high_cross) {
        best_sim <- devsim
        best_sim$cross <- y_cross0.5_devsim
      }
    }
  }
}

# Overall single boxplot summary.
{
  # Helper function to generate clean, readable model names for the plots
  clean_name_fn <- function(x) {
    city <- ifelse(grepl("Ajax", x), "Ajax", "Pickering")
    metric <- ifelse(grepl("percentchange", x), "Percent Change", "Percent")
    age <- case_when(
      grepl("Elementary", x) ~ "Elementary",
      grepl("Secondary", x) ~ "Secondary",
      grepl("Total", x) ~ "Total"
    )
    sma <- case_when(
      grepl("1d", x) ~ "1-day (raw)",
      grepl("3d", x) ~ "3-day SMA",
      grepl("5d", x) ~ "5-day SMA",
      grepl("7d", x) ~ "7-day SMA"
    )
    paste(city, metric, age, sma, sep = "\n")
  }

  # Helper function to filter out non-significant comparisons to prevent empty brackets
  get_sig_comps <- function(df, formula, method = "wilcox.test") {
    st <- ggpubr::compare_means(formula, data = df, method = method)
    st <- st[st$p < 0.05, ]
    if (nrow(st) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    comps <- list()
    for (i in 1:nrow(st)) {
      comps[[i]] <- as.character(c(st$group1[i], st$group2[i]))
    }
    return(comps)
  }

  # Add manual jitter for perfect ggrepel alignment
  set.seed(42)
  all_metrics$x_jitter <- 1 + runif(nrow(all_metrics), -0.2, 0.2)

  # Identify top 5 models
  top5_models <- all_metrics %>%
    arrange(desc(DevianceExplained)) %>%
    head(5)
  top5_models$short_name <- clean_name_fn(top5_models$file)

  overall_plot <- ggplot(all_metrics, aes(y = DevianceExplained)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = 1), width = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(aes(x = x_jitter, color = Metric), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(top5_models, x_jitter < 1),
      aes(x = x_jitter, label = short_name),
      size = 2.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      box.padding = 0.5,
      nudge_x = -0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      direction = "y",
      xlim = c(NA, 0.7),
      force = 10,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(top5_models, x_jitter >= 1),
      aes(x = x_jitter, label = short_name),
      size = 2.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      box.padding = 0.5,
      nudge_x = 0.5,
      hjust = 0,
      direction = "y",
      xlim = c(1.3, NA),
      force = 10,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Incidence" = "#E64B35", "Prevalence" = "#4DBBD5")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1, labels = "All GAMs Tested", limits = c(0, 2)) +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of Deviance Explained Across All Tested GAMs",
      x = "",
      y = "Deviance Explained",
      color = "Metric Type"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )

  print(overall_plot)
}

# Top 5 Monte Carlo comparison.
{
  # Extract the Monte Carlo files corresponding to the top 5 models
  top5_mc_files <- gsub("metrics.xlsx", "Monte-Carlo.xlsx", top5_models$file)

  # Pool the 1000 Monte Carlo iterations for these top 5 models
  mc_list <- list()
  for (mc_file in top5_mc_files) {
    if (!is.null(data_list[[mc_file]])) {
      df <- data_list[[mc_file]]
      df$model_name <- clean_name_fn(mc_file)
      mc_list[[mc_file]] <- df
    }
  }
  top5_mc_data <- bind_rows(mc_list)

  # Ensure factors are ordered by median Deviance Explained so the plot looks clean
  top5_mc_data$model_name <- factor(top5_mc_data$model_name, levels = top5_models$short_name)

  # Calculate 95% Confidence Intervals for Deviance Explained
  mc_ci_summary <- top5_mc_data %>%
    group_by(model_name) %>%
    summarize(
      Lower_CI = quantile(mean_dev, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = median(mean_dev, na.rm = TRUE),
      Upper_CI = quantile(mean_dev, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  print("95% Confidence Intervals for Top 5 Models (Deviance Explained):")
  print(mc_ci_summary)

  # Plot the distributions
  mc_showdown_plot <- ggplot(top5_mc_data, aes(x = model_name, y = mean_dev, fill = model_name)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", lineheight = 0.8)) +
    labs(
      title = "Top 5 Models: Monte Carlo Performance Showdown",
      subtitle = "Distributions over 1,000 Iterations (Superiority determined by 95% CI non-overlap)",
      x = "Model Configuration",
      y = "Monte Carlo Deviance Explained"
    )

  print(mc_showdown_plot)
}

# Overall deviance explained summary plot.
{
  # Filter comparisons
  sig_city_dev <- get_sig_comps(all_metrics, DevianceExplained ~ City)
  sig_sma_dev <- get_sig_comps(all_metrics, DevianceExplained ~ SMA)
  sig_age_dev <- get_sig_comps(all_metrics, DevianceExplained ~ Age)

  p2 <- ggplot(all_metrics, aes(x = SMA, y = DevianceExplained, fill = SMA)) +

    labs(x = "", y = "")

  p4 <- ggplot(all_metrics, aes(x = Metric, y = DevianceExplained, fill = Metric)) +

}

# Overall concurvity summary plot.
{
  file_matches_conc <- list.files(pattern = ".*_GAM-concurvity.xlsx", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(file_matches_conc) > 0) {
    if (!requireNamespace("tidyr", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tidyr")

    conc_list <- list()
    for (file in file_matches_conc) {
      df <- read_excel(file, col_names = TRUE)
      if (nrow(df) > 0) {
        filename <- basename(file)

        # Extract metadata from filename
        df$City <- ifelse(grepl("Pickering", filename), "Pickering", "Ajax")
        df$Metric <- ifelse(grepl("percentchange", filename), "Incidence", "Prevalence")
        df$Age <- ifelse(grepl("Elementary", filename), "Elementary",
          ifelse(grepl("Secondary", filename), "Secondary", "Total")
        )
        df$SMA <- ifelse(grepl("1d", filename), "1-day",
          ifelse(grepl("3d", filename), "3-day",
            ifelse(grepl("5d", filename), "5-day", "7-day")
          )
        )

        # Melt to long format
        long_df <- tidyr::pivot_longer(df, cols = -c(Term, City, Metric, Age, SMA), names_to = "Term2", values_to = "Concurvity")

        # Clean up term names for plotting
        clean_terms <- function(x) {
          x <- gsub("s\\(", "", x)
          x <- gsub("\\)", "", x)
          x <- gsub("Norodata7d", "Norovirus", x)
          x <- gsub("EVdata7d", "Enterovirus", x)
          x <- gsub("InfAdata7d", "Influenza A", x)
          return(x)
        }
        long_df$Term <- clean_terms(long_df$Term)
        long_df$Term2 <- clean_terms(long_df$Term2)

        conc_list[[filename]] <- long_df
      }
    }

    all_conc <- bind_rows(conc_list)

    # Filter out 'para' (parametric terms like intercept) if present
    all_conc <- all_conc %>% filter(Term != "para", Term2 != "para")

    # Aggregate to get average concurvity across models
    agg_conc <- all_conc %>%
      group_by(City, SMA, Term, Term2) %>%
      summarize(Mean_Concurvity = mean(Concurvity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    # Plot Heatmap
    conc_plot <- ggplot(agg_conc, aes(x = Term, y = Term2, fill = Mean_Concurvity)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white") +
      facet_grid(City ~ SMA) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#E64B35", limits = c(0, 1), name = "Concurvity") +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(Mean_Concurvity, 2)), color = "black", size = 3) +
      labs(
        title = "Pairwise Pathogen Concurvity (Shared Variance)",
        subtitle = "Averaged across age groups and metric types",
        x = "",
        y = ""
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        text = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
      )

    print(conc_plot)
  }

  # Audit v5 figures generation.
  print("Generating Audit v5 Figures...")
  
  # Ensure Figures directory exists
  figures_dir <- file.path(PROJ, "Figures")
  if(!dir.exists(figures_dir)) dir.create(figures_dir)

  # 1. Drop-in-Deviance Comparison
  # Collect deviance drops
  drop_data <- list()
  metrics_keys <- names(data_list)[str_detect(names(data_list), pattern = ".*_GAM-metrics.xlsx")]
  for(k in metrics_keys) {
    dfm <- data_list[[k]]
    if(nrow(dfm) > 0 && "NoroDropDevPct" %in% names(dfm)) {
       row <- dfm[1,]
       drop_data[[k]] <- data.frame(
          Model = k,
          Enterovirus = row$EVDropDevPct,
          Norovirus_GII = row$NoroDropDevPct,
          Influenza_A = row$InfADropDevPct
       )
    }
  }
  if(length(drop_data) > 0) {
    drop_df <- do.call(rbind, drop_data)
    drop_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(drop_df, cols=c("Enterovirus", "Norovirus_GII", "Influenza_A"), names_to="Predictor", values_to="DropPct")
    
    fig_drop <- ggplot(drop_long, aes(x=Predictor, y=DropPct, fill=Predictor)) +
      geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7, outlier.shape=NA) +
      geom_jitter(width=0.2, alpha=0.6, size=2, color="black") +
      geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="red") +
      labs(title="Unique Contribution to Accuracy (Drop-in-Deviance)",
           y="Loss in Deviance Explained (%) when Predictor Removed",
           x="") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Enterovirus"="red", "Influenza_A"="purple", "Norovirus_GII"="green")) +
      theme(legend.position="none")
    
    ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "fig_drop_in_deviance.png"), plot=fig_drop, width=8, height=6, bg="white")
    print("Saved fig_drop_in_deviance.png")
  }

  # 2. Stochastic Simulation Degradation (Pre vs Post-log)
  mc_files <- list.files(pattern = ".*_GAM-Monte-Carlo.xlsx", full.names = TRUE)
  mc_data_list <- list()
  for(file in mc_files) {
    base_file <- basename(file)
    metric_file <- paste0(substr(base_file, 1, nchar(base_file) - 16), "metrics.xlsx")
    if(metric_file %in% names(data_list) && nrow(data_list[[metric_file]]) > 0) {
      offset <- as.character(data_list[[metric_file]]$Offset[1])
      tryCatch({
        post_df <- read_excel(file, sheet=paste0(offset, "_postlog"))
        pre_df <- read_excel(file, sheet=paste0(offset, "_prelog"))
        
        post_df$Scheme <- "Post-log (Downstream Noise)"
        post_df$Model <- base_file
        
        pre_df$Scheme <- "Pre-log (Assay Noise)"
        pre_df$Model <- base_file
        
        mc_data_list[[paste0(base_file,"_post")]] <- post_df[,c("Model", "noise_level", "mean_dev", "Scheme")]
        mc_data_list[[paste0(base_file,"_pre")]] <- pre_df[,c("Model", "noise_level", "mean_dev", "Scheme")]
      }, error=function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  if(length(mc_data_list) > 0) {
    mc_all <- do.call(rbind, mc_data_list)
    mc_agg <- mc_all %>% group_by(Scheme, noise_level) %>%
      summarise(median_dev = median(mean_dev, na.rm=TRUE),
                q25 = quantile(mean_dev, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE),
                q75 = quantile(mean_dev, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
                
    fig_mc <- ggplot(mc_agg, aes(x=noise_level, y=median_dev, color=Scheme, fill=Scheme)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=q25, ymax=q75), alpha=0.2, color=NA) +
      geom_line(size=1.2) +
      geom_point() +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale=100)) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale=100)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept=0.5, linetype="dotted", color="black") +
      labs(title="Model Resilience to Simulated Noise",
           subtitle="Solid line indicates median across retained models; ribbon is IQR",
           x="Simulated Noise Magnitude (Relative to Predictor SD)",
           y="Deviance Explained") +
      theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
      theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title=element_blank())
      
    ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "fig_monte_carlo_noise.png"), plot=fig_mc, width=8, height=6, bg="white")
    print("Saved fig_monte_carlo_noise.png")
  }

  # 3. Top Model Fit (Pickering_percentElementaryAbsent7d)
  top_model_val_file <- file.path(PROJ, RESULTS_DIR,
    "Pickering_percentElementaryAbsent7d_GAM-values.xlsx")
  if(file.exists(top_model_val_file)) {
     top_df <- read_excel(top_model_val_file)
     if ("TotalAbsences" %in% names(top_df) && "fitted" %in% names(top_df) && "Day" %in% names(top_df)) {
         fig_top <- ggplot(top_df, aes(x=Day)) +
           geom_point(aes(y=TotalAbsences, color="Observed"), size=2, alpha=0.6) +
           geom_line(aes(y=fitted, color="Fitted"), size=1.2) +
           scale_color_manual(values=c("Observed"="black", "Fitted"="#1f77b4")) +
           labs(title="Top Model Performance: Pickering Elementary (7-day SMA)",
                subtitle="Deviance Explained: 97%",
                x="Date",
                y="Percent Absent due to Illness (%)") +
           theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
           theme(legend.title=element_blank(), legend.position="top")
         
         ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "fig_top_model_fit.png"), plot=fig_top, width=10, height=5, bg="white")
         print("Saved fig_top_model_fit.png")
     }
  }
}
```

```{r Attribution and concurvity by family, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
# Compute attribution and concurvity summaries by family.
{
  base_dir <- file.path(PROJ, RESULTS_DIR)
  vir <- c(NoV = "Noro", EV = "EV", InfA = "InfA")

  mfiles <- list.files(base_dir, pattern = "_GAM-metrics\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
  met <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mfiles, function(f) {
    d <- suppressMessages(read_excel(f))
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
    d$model <- sub("_GAM-metrics\\.xlsx$", "", basename(f))
    as.data.frame(d)
  }))

  if (is.null(met) || nrow(met) == 0) {
    cat("No metrics workbooks found in", base_dir, "-- attribution summary skipped.\n")
  } else {
    if ("ACFResidual" %in% names(met)) met <- met[abs(met$ACFResidual) <= 0.4, ]
    met$family <- ifelse(grepl("percentchange", met$model),
      "incidence (gaussian)", "prevalence (betar)")

    # Detect available univariate metric columns.
    have <- function(suffix) all(paste0(vir, suffix) %in% names(met))
    winner <- function(d, suffix, dir) {
      cols <- paste0(vir, suffix)
      m <- as.matrix(d[, cols, drop = FALSE])
      idx <- if (dir == "max") max.col(m, ties.method = "first") else max.col(-m, ties.method = "first")
      names(vir)[idx]
    }

    crits <- list(
      list(lbl = "drop-in-deviance (largest)", sfx = "DropDevPct", dir = "max"),
      list(lbl = "univariate deviance (highest)", sfx = "SingleDevPct", dir = "max"),
      list(lbl = "univariate AICc (lowest)", sfx = "SingleAICc", dir = "min")
    )

    cat("\n===== ATTRIBUTION BY FAMILY =====\n")
    for (cr in crits) {
      if (!have(cr$sfx)) {
        cat("\n--", cr$lbl, ": columns not present, skipped\n"); next
      }
      met$.win <- winner(met, cr$sfx, cr$dir)
      tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(met, met$family), function(g) {
        med <- sapply(vir, function(v) round(median(g[[paste0(v, cr$sfx)]], na.rm = TRUE), 2))
        data.frame(
          family = g$family[1], models = nrow(g),
          EV_wins = sum(g$.win == "EV"), NoV_wins = sum(g$.win == "NoV"),
          InfA_wins = sum(g$.win == "InfA"),
          median_EV = med[["EV"]], median_NoV = med[["NoV"]], median_InfA = med[["InfA"]],
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }))
      cat("\n--", cr$lbl, "\n"); print(tab, row.names = FALSE)
    }

    # Compute univariate AICc margin.
    if (have("SingleAICc")) {
      met$.dAICc <- pmin(met$NoroSingleAICc, met$InfASingleAICc) - met$EVSingleAICc
      cat("\n-- univariate AICc margin for EV over the next-best single predictor\n")
      print(do.call(rbind, lapply(split(met, met$family), function(g) data.frame(
        family = g$family[1], models = nrow(g),
        median_dAICc = round(median(g$.dAICc, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        min_dAICc = round(min(g$.dAICc, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        max_dAICc = round(max(g$.dAICc, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        favours_EV = sum(g$.dAICc > 0, na.rm = TRUE), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))), row.names = FALSE)
    }

    # Compute smooth term concurvity summaries.
    conc_pairs <- function(kind) {
      fs <- list.files(base_dir, pattern = paste0("_GAM-concurvity", kind, "\\.xlsx$"),
        full.names = TRUE)
      do.call(rbind, lapply(fs, function(f) {
        d <- as.data.frame(suppressMessages(read_excel(f)))
        id <- sub(paste0("_GAM-concurvity", kind, "\\.xlsx$"), "", basename(f))
        rn <- d[[1]]; m <- as.matrix(d[, -1, drop = FALSE])
        rownames(m) <- rn
        keep_r <- rownames(m) != "para"; keep_c <- colnames(m) != "para"
        m <- m[keep_r, keep_c, drop = FALSE]
        v <- m[row(m) != col(m)]
        data.frame(model = id, value = as.numeric(v),
          family = ifelse(grepl("percentchange", id), "incidence (gaussian)", "prevalence (betar)"),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }))
    }

    cat("\n===== CONCURVITY BY FAMILY (smooth-smooth pairs, para excluded) =====\n")
    kinds <- c(worst = "-worst", estimate = "", observed = "-observed")
    cc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(kinds), function(nm) {
      p <- conc_pairs(kinds[[nm]])
      if (is.null(p) || nrow(p) == 0) return(NULL)
      p$measure <- nm
      p
    }))
    if (!is.null(cc) && nrow(cc) > 0) {
      print(do.call(rbind, lapply(split(cc, list(cc$family, cc$measure), drop = TRUE), function(g)
        data.frame(family = g$family[1], measure = g$measure[1], pairs = nrow(g),
          median = round(median(g$value), 3), max = round(max(g$value), 3),
          pairs_ge_0.8 = sum(g$value >= 0.8),
          models_ge_0.8 = length(unique(g$model[g$value >= 0.8])),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE))), row.names = FALSE)
    }

    # Read stochastic simulation robustness results if available.
    attr_cand <- c(
      file.path(PROJ, "Stochastic Simulation Outputs REMOTE"),
      file.path(PROJ, "Stochastic Simulation Outputs"),
      file.path(dirname(base_dir), "Stochastic Simulation Outputs REMOTE"),
      file.path(dirname(base_dir), "Stochastic Simulation Outputs")
    )
    attr_dir <- attr_cand[dir.exists(attr_cand)][1]
    if (!is.na(attr_dir)) {
      for (f in c("B1-k-sweep-summary.xlsx", "B2-bootstrap-summary.xlsx",
        "B2-block-length-sweep.xlsx")) {
        p <- file.path(attr_dir, f)
        if (file.exists(p)) {
          cat("\n=====", sub("\\.xlsx$", "", f), "=====\n")
          print(as.data.frame(suppressMessages(read_excel(p))), row.names = FALSE)
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
